latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Knowledge Card Factory – a fully automated workflow for creating and publishing knowledge cards.

- Enables end-to-end automation: topic discovery, deep content mining, AI-generated illustration, and cross-platform publishing.
- Integrates with platforms like Xiaohongshu for automated content push.
- Flexible card styles (Mac Pro, cyberpunk, minimalist, etc.) and workflow configuration.
- Robust error handling: retries, downgrade strategies, and draft saving on publishing failure.
- Extensible with custom templates, data sources, and new publishing channels.
